title: Hard-wired start/stop with a relay (no PLC)
description: Build the classic seal-in: START latches a relay through its own contact, STOP (normally closed) releases it, and a lamp shows the state.
objectives: START then release keeps the lamp on (the relay seals itself in)
STOP drops it out and it stays off when STOP is released
No PLC and no program anywhere
hints: Put START in parallel with a NO contact of the relay, then STOP in series with both
The relay coil is A1/A2; its NO contacts are 13-14 and 23-24
Feed the lamp from the second contact so the coil and the lamp circuits stay separate
